Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 25, "heading": "CHAPTER 23. I CORROBORATE Mr. DICK, AND CHOOSE A PROFESSION", "previous_rows": [], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 23, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u025-h", "tag": "h2", "role": "heading", "text": "CHAPTER 23. I CORROBORATE Mr. DICK, AND CHOOSE A PROFESSION", "sha256": "18d01a6e9ef63759ce740acc8e23d70ab8ce0efbdf92bf49844f0420380842f9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/h2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0001", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "When I awoke in the morning I thought very much of little Em’ly, and her emotion last night, after Martha had left. I felt as if I had come into the knowledge of those domestic weaknesses and tendernesses in a sacred confidence, and that to disclose them, even to Steerforth, would be wrong. I had no gentler feeling towards anyone than towards the pretty creature who had been my playmate, and whom I have always been persuaded, and shall always be persuaded, to my dying day, I then devotedly loved. The repetition to any ears—even to Steerforth’s—of what she had been unable to repress when her heart lay open to me by an accident, I felt would be a rough deed, unworthy of myself, unworthy of the light of our pure childhood, which I always saw encircling her head. I made a resolution, therefore, to keep it in my own breast; and there it gave her image a new grace.", "sha256": "559ec2753392c1e4013d1f6c5f734c1f88458b0911fb2478ebb5eda21a76d5ab", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[1]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0002", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "While we were at breakfast, a letter was delivered to me from my aunt. As it contained matter on which I thought Steerforth could advise me as well as anyone, and on which I knew I should be delighted to consult him, I resolved to make it a subject of discussion on our journey home. For the present we had enough to do, in taking leave of all our friends. Mr. Barkis was far from being the last among them, in his regret at our departure; and I believe would even have opened the box again, and sacrificed another guinea, if it would have kept us eight-and-forty hours in Yarmouth. Peggotty and all her family were full of grief at our going. The whole house of Omer and Joram turned out to bid us good-bye; and there were so many seafaring volunteers in attendance on Steerforth, when our portmanteaux went to the coach, that if we had had the baggage of a regiment with us, we should hardly have wanted porters to carry it. In a word, we departed to the regret and admiration of all concerned, and left a great many people very sorry behind US.", "sha256": "82cf7fe49eec1029b0a3ab8a79a3ae7e8d69916f2f5a01950eabd35c34d9cee4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[2]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0003", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Do you stay long here, Littimer?’ said I, as he stood waiting to see the coach start.", "sha256": "5312cc8acd0cfed157017189e66871db2b81096d47994254c4830245a1b12eaf", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[3]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0004", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No, sir,’ he replied; ‘probably not very long, sir.’", "sha256": "71a44e0fdb550900d9f6d4513e833048e9bb5791c29a400af36e44789de77434", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[4]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0005", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘He can hardly say, just now,’ observed Steerforth, carelessly. ‘He knows what he has to do, and he’ll do it.’", "sha256": "1512c18985a40dd803ac4ca9a5a9c7dbe177690f2d6bf3cb794ff43e5764d0ed", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[5]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0006", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘That I am sure he will,’ said I.", "sha256": "e6223ea2a38153d438840761f9b9a213c67a338e94eb0c0545807def0d849536", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[6]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0007", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Littimer touched his hat in acknowledgement of my good opinion, and I felt about eight years old. He touched it once more, wishing us a good journey; and we left him standing on the pavement, as respectable a mystery as any pyramid in Egypt.", "sha256": "a886399dee594226390e6bcde87e204b443433c119e48b188d01cbd323237941", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[7]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0008", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "For some little time we held no conversation, Steerforth being unusually silent, and I being sufficiently engaged in wondering, within myself, when I should see the old places again, and what new changes might happen to me or them in the meanwhile. At length Steerforth, becoming gay and talkative in a moment, as he could become anything he liked at any moment, pulled me by the arm:", "sha256": "9f303baca955e8a8bb1e7c200b976cc68deae0ac33fc6741fa394d322b1a199a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[8]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0009", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Find a voice, David. What about that letter you were speaking of at breakfast?’", "sha256": "4274ddb1d30e419c6f1d65ea787c4d99d29cbc6b653ac940a094595cef595cb4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[9]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0010", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Oh!’ said I, taking it out of my pocket. ‘It’s from my aunt.’", "sha256": "722f721b04c4ce861fc61a485058ee26e43d07f0f5eb8ecc69a74d39215ab822", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[10]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0011", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘And what does she say, requiring consideration?’", "sha256": "9314552043da3f7f2281d9cd5e98783913521a555ea2e50e4051cf605e7d6e99", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[11]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0012", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Why, she reminds me, Steerforth,’ said I, ‘that I came out on this expedition to look about me, and to think a little.’", "sha256": "3a43354221eb06c7e0954cffb1c6ab7a2acf8340ca7e03d0a590ad60475cf483", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[12]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0013", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Which, of course, you have done?’", "sha256": "2ed1b7973f4d78aa280ec9f8f23d4ceca271dc77a985458432a09f6f43f01954", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[13]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0014", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Indeed I can’t say I have, particularly. To tell you the truth, I am afraid I have forgotten it.’", "sha256": "ba5413249f15e64268f91d1575ac9a80016fe4066cd5f787502885f7a16c29f6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[14]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0015", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Well! look about you now, and make up for your negligence,’ said Steerforth. ‘Look to the right, and you’ll see a flat country, with a good deal of marsh in it; look to the left, and you’ll see the same. Look to the front, and you’ll find no difference; look to the rear, and there it is still.’ I laughed, and replied that I saw no suitable profession in the whole prospect; which was perhaps to be attributed to its flatness.", "sha256": "081d1be27ceda526952a02a8381172cd27536273e0cd31d8307844201692f136", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[15]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0016", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What says our aunt on the subject?’ inquired Steerforth, glancing at the letter in my hand. ‘Does she suggest anything?’", "sha256": "36484938138df9c5c20bcd7dbf926cbab60bfd6ab7cda997d28109f2bd714193", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[16]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0017", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Why, yes,’ said I. ‘She asks me, here, if I think I should like to be a proctor? What do you think of it?’", "sha256": "7ceca45d334cb31cd10c88c93eb61aa8da9c4ff12b7887df81d8b1836c0a5df5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[17]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0018", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Well, I don’t know,’ replied Steerforth, coolly. ‘You may as well do that as anything else, I suppose?’", "sha256": "1b6f4b42c374365deb13311bfefe6827b1280225823f41b9d78f149a5d5f5801", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[18]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0019", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I could not help laughing again, at his balancing all callings and professions so equally; and I told him so.", "sha256": "0ca6d28263237e5d531f112ca93f33c67236ddc03dc2c36dcc6954255bf1aad7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[19]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0020", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What is a proctor, Steerforth?’ said I.", "sha256": "6166076cccf1c6971c50626857606129c6f35c271347b34525225d9bcd23eca8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[20]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0021", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Why, he is a sort of monkish attorney,’ replied Steerforth. ‘He is, to some faded courts held in Doctors’ Commons,—a lazy old nook near St. Paul’s Churchyard—what solicitors are to the courts of law and equity. He is a functionary whose existence, in the natural course of things, would have terminated about two hundred years ago. I can tell you best what he is, by telling you what Doctors’ Commons is. It’s a little out-of-the-way place, where they administer what is called ecclesiastical law, and play all kinds of tricks with obsolete old monsters of acts of Parliament, which three-fourths of the world know nothing about, and the other fourth supposes to have been dug up, in a fossil state, in the days of the Edwards. It’s a place that has an ancient monopoly in suits about people’s wills and people’s marriages, and disputes among ships and boats.’", "sha256": "bb4b6fdb4fc28a129217fcaeb0b4be37845fc77bb7894cf94c902751a4290f53", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[21]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0022", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Nonsense, Steerforth!’ I exclaimed. ‘You don’t mean to say that there is any affinity between nautical matters and ecclesiastical matters?’", "sha256": "405edd5001f5b11eff88e2dc7fe1d290b2b57489c40e469c835b9e8b2d714413", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[22]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0023", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I don’t, indeed, my dear boy,’ he returned; ‘but I mean to say that they are managed and decided by the same set of people, down in that same Doctors’ Commons. You shall go there one day, and find them blundering through half the nautical terms in Young’s Dictionary, apropos of the “Nancy” having run down the “Sarah Jane”, or Mr. Peggotty and the Yarmouth boatmen having put off in a gale of wind with an anchor and cable to the “Nelson” Indiaman in distress; and you shall go there another day, and find them deep in the evidence, pro and con, respecting a clergyman who has misbehaved himself; and you shall find the judge in the nautical case, the advocate in the clergyman’s case, or contrariwise. They are like actors: now a man’s a judge, and now he is not a judge; now he’s one thing, now he’s another; now he’s something else, change and change about; but it’s always a very pleasant, profitable little affair of private theatricals, presented to an uncommonly select audience.’", "sha256": "b95062c7ec5bf5bf7016ca597983064ef8bef568edbffbfea8bd724c0fce0395", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[23]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0024", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘But advocates and proctors are not one and the same?’ said I, a little puzzled. ‘Are they?’", "sha256": "c09027707f5bbda678843f38bf3b5cbaef28dbd47e71c69ed8fc4de32abd865e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[24]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0025", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No,’ returned Steerforth, ‘the advocates are civilians—men who have taken a doctor’s degree at college—which is the first reason of my knowing anything about it. The proctors employ the advocates. Both get very comfortable fees, and altogether they make a mighty snug little party. On the whole, I would recommend you to take to Doctors’ Commons kindly, David. They plume themselves on their gentility there, I can tell you, if that’s any satisfaction.’", "sha256": "df7dc790d6827a7f5d680ef9204e94eab3c8e57ef86baa43cff9c1dc87de9bb9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[25]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0026", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I made allowance for Steerforth’s light way of treating the subject, and, considering it with reference to the staid air of gravity and antiquity which I associated with that ‘lazy old nook near St. Paul’s Churchyard’, did not feel indisposed towards my aunt’s suggestion; which she left to my free decision, making no scruple of telling me that it had occurred to her, on her lately visiting her own proctor in Doctors’ Commons for the purpose of settling her will in my favour.", "sha256": "b426d03b3dd90ea414aff5d0b52f507fbbd346eb261daa7cd15247ae0acf8bef", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[26]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0027", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘That’s a laudable proceeding on the part of our aunt, at all events,’ said Steerforth, when I mentioned it; ‘and one deserving of all encouragement. Daisy, my advice is that you take kindly to Doctors’ Commons.’", "sha256": "1fbb78cef8235475b2dda5b0c061489e08b06f4263b26c9a2e8f0134a3939f3b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[27]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0028", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I quite made up my mind to do so. I then told Steerforth that my aunt was in town awaiting me (as I found from her letter), and that she had taken lodgings for a week at a kind of private hotel at Lincoln’s Inn Fields, where there was a stone staircase, and a convenient door in the roof; my aunt being firmly persuaded that every house in London was going to be burnt down every night.", "sha256": "3625a2bfbeb57c308c2191d2410826963049892b6f858419994f7d496b022059", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[28]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0029", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "We achieved the rest of our journey pleasantly, sometimes recurring to Doctors’ Commons, and anticipating the distant days when I should be a proctor there, which Steerforth pictured in a variety of humorous and whimsical lights, that made us both merry. When we came to our journey’s end, he went home, engaging to call upon me next day but one; and I drove to Lincoln’s Inn Fields, where I found my aunt up, and waiting supper.", "sha256": "c2b7f317e68eed85df1031a373e2dab92936eafb1cbb730a09d28277a85bc73e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[29]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0030", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "If I had been round the world since we parted, we could hardly have been better pleased to meet again. My aunt cried outright as she embraced me; and said, pretending to laugh, that if my poor mother had been alive, that silly little creature would have shed tears, she had no doubt.", "sha256": "bae9e658c3197d74b04a9af3f7e30c4c1a4c100a7200df9c325f316318740668", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[30]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u025-b0031", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘So you have left Mr. Dick behind, aunt?’ said I. ‘I am sorry for that. Ah, Janet, how do you do?’", "sha256": "01e4b51b511811d25b095630d03a6727dbe14ae17f6c70bb3915febcd00eb4ec", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[30]/p[31]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
